name: Keeper Ruairí

intro.text: You'll be the one who's been tidying up after the Enclosure all over the islands. Grand. Welcome to the yard.
They built ships here you could see from space, near enough. Iron creatures are the same. Slow to start, impossible to stop.

win: Well riveted. The Iron Stone's yours, and take the lantern off the hook by the door. Caves up north are darker than they look.
after: Mind the cranes on your way out. Samson's in a mood.
